# agent-control-plane — Active Invariants

## acp.jobs.node-execution-ownership

A managed schedule has a non-empty static owner set of logical HRC node IDs or the explicit all-nodes wildcard. Every member independently admits one local copy; this is deliberate N-way fan-out, not failover. ACP authorizes each scheduler tick and manual admission with one fresh HRC status identity, transactionally re-reads enabled state and owner membership, and stamps the verified admitting node on the JobRun before side effects. The definition owner set is authorization only and is never copied as a run's singular identity. All later lifecycle work stays on the immutable stamped node. Federated unassigned work fails closed; single-node legacy unassigned work implicitly belongs to the current node. Disabled blocks admission only and does not orphan inflight work.

## agent-control-plane.agent-inspection-adapter

ACP hosts the shared read-only agent inspection HTTP contract at GET /admin/agents with optional projectId and POST /admin/agents/:agentId/inspect. The handlers validate identifiers and forward only those identifiers and declared inspection overrides to the Agent Spaces authority configured with ACP's trusted project-id resolver. ACP never constructs, receives, caches, or forwards filesystem roots, environment snapshots, clocks, probe results, scaffolds, or compile context. Taskboard's same-path routes remain transparent consumers of these ACP endpoints, and an optional ACP operational dossier remains separate enrichment that cannot define roster membership or producer configuration.

## agent-control-plane.asp-hrc-consumer-coherence

ACP selects one exact canonical ASP package set and one exact canonical HRC package set across every direct and transitive bun.lock edge. EXPECTED_CONSUMER_PRODUCERS is ACP's sole identity authority for each set's name, repository, canonical remote, source commit, and concrete version; membership is derived from the exact praesidiumBuild tuples carried by locked and installed package manifests under the imported producer publication predicates, never from a hand-maintained package list. Every derived member has a root override at the set version, every ACP-authored dependency or devDependency edge naming it uses that exact version, and every lock and installed selection agrees with the tuple. Registry latest is advisory for ASP/HRC: routine dependency sync cannot advance either tuple, routine install is frozen, and only the explicit operator advance may change the identity, manifests, overrides, and lock as one confined uncommitted diff while preserving unrelated lock resolutions. The wrkq stream remains outside this authority and independently follows latest. Every selected tarball uses the canonical mini registry locator and its lock integrity is cache-empty fetchable. The served ACP deployment readback must agree with HRC's atomic running release, including its locked ASP tuple and runningEqualsInstalled=true. This consumer invariant imports producer predicates agent-spaces.canonical-package-publication and hrc-runtime.canonical-package-publication plus hrc-runtime.observable-release; it does not redefine producer contracts.

## agent-control-plane.discord-room-ledger-egress

Gateway-discord tails wrkq envelope.created once on one monotonic cursor and fans each envelope out to independent sinks: the configured control-plane root mirror is always selected, and an eligible routed bare-principal human notice is additionally selected. The mirror is an unconditional, non-authoritative observer and never writes an envelope presentation; only the human-notice sink preserves that receipt. Both renders carry the EN id. Delivery state is durable per gateway, envelope, and sink: one atomic write increments a persistent attempt counter and sets attempting before every send, observed successful responses are written sent, exhausted sends become failed, and the cursor advances only after every sink is sent or failed. Startup reconciliation adopts an attempting send only when its EN id is found in the last 100 messages of that sink's target; a miss resends only while the persistent maxDeliveryAttempts budget remains. This feed bounds webhook 429 retries without changing the unbounded default used by existing event feeds. Sender handles use parseScopeHandle, and room project is resolved from the room rather than inferred from the sender. With the control-plane channel unset, the root mirror is disabled; the human-notice subtext change remains independent and live.

## agent-control-plane.mobile-timeline-projection

ACP is the sole mobile timeline projector. For one exact sessionRef, hostSessionId, generation, HRC-ledger incarnation, and wrkq-ledger incarnation, it persists one rebuildable projection epoch of presentation atoms keyed by canonical source identity. Each atom carries immutable projected content, logical-frame grouping metadata, append-or-replace operation, source position, and an immutable signed timeline ordinal. Mutable wrkq obligation and envelope state are excluded from the atom and from cursor progress; any such UI state is a separately refreshed overlay. Admission is serialized and transactional per exact session. Every epoch persists an immutable origin timeline boundary at ordinal zero independently of atom existence. A first closed newest cohort and forward atoms occupy ordinals at or above the origin, while closed older cohorts prepend at negative ordinals. Live and bounded forward catch-up preserve each producer's sequence and append in durable ACP admission order. Each epoch also persists exclusive per-source reverse frontiers separately from admitted-atom positions and newest high-waters. A frontier starts at one above the captured producer head when the cohort consumed no row (one for an empty head), otherwise at the lowest raw row consumed; older scans advance it to the lowest raw row examined even when rows project away, deduplicate, or are suppressed. Live and forward admission cannot advance a reverse frontier, and exhaustion is inferred only from producer older-availability plus full raw-row consumption. Source timestamps never reorder admitted atoms, and replay, reconnect, page repetition, or buffered live delivery cannot renumber an admitted source identity. Numeric exhaustion and a non-contiguous admitted-source range fail through an explicit projection reset. Every open captures both producer heads and incarnations and stages reconciliation under hard ceilings of 2,048 raw records or projected atoms and 16 MiB of encoded/projected work. Complete catch-up commits at the live end. Catch-up that cannot reach both captured heads within either ceiling commits nothing, retires the old epoch, and builds one bounded closed newest epoch at the captured vector. A single oversize atom fails without cursor advance. The same ceilings govern first snapshots and older-page admission. ACP-owned canonical history cursor v2 binds its type and version, exact session identity, both producer incarnations, projection epoch and origin, an exclusive timeline coordinate naming either the origin or a committed atom boundary, and the exclusive reverse frontiers plus producer high-waters. Legacy v1 epochs retire rather than being reinterpreted. Malformed encoding is 400; wrong type, future position, fence mismatch, retired epoch, or replaced producer incarnation is 409 cursor_invalid with no atoms. Snapshot construction buffers source arrivals beyond its captured vector, emits one newest bounded snapshot, and then admits each later source identity once. Reset state replaces rather than merges epochs; no cursor, connection, or client store may apply atoms across an epoch boundary. A bounded older scan may return no atoms while advancing its source vector. Before first return, ACP transactionally persists a page receipt keyed by projection epoch, canonical request-cursor digest, normalized requested limit, and response contract version. Exact-tuple replay returns that receipt without a producer read or progress mutation, never returns more atoms than its recorded limit, and active receipts retire only with their epoch. Clients union by atom id and order by timeline ordinal. Logical frame id is grouping metadata only: adjacent append atoms may coalesce, non-adjacent same-frame atoms remain at their own ordinals, and replace atoms suppress older replace presentation without moving unrelated atoms. Prefix completeness is unknown until an authoritative start atom or source exhaustion. Historical prepend preserves atom anchors and follow state; initial and explicit reset snapshots bottom once.

## agent-control-plane.plugin-lifecycle-event-adapter

ACP exclusively owns opaque plugin-event cursors binding HRC ledger incarnation and sequence, resolves every subscription against current HRC authority, and opens the typed bounded HRC stream with both asserted values. It forwards the canonical event envelope and ordered gaps without treating advisory ready as progress, maps pre-admission or live ledger replacement to cursor_invalid, and never resumes a sequence across incarnations. The adapter holds at most one decoded record outside the typed client buffer, stops pulling at its fixed WebSocket buffered-byte ceiling, and closes a slow consumer without an application replay array. It uses the configured ACP facade and existing transport/authentication policy with no route-specific capability, permission, consent, redaction, or loopback gate, and it does not reuse the mobile event-pump or diagnostics sender.
